name: Private web store for enterprise extensions

mentions.name: Private web store for enterprise extensions
mentions.description: A private web store that enterprises can switch to instead of the default extension stores, created in response to ransomware and malware activity in the extension-store space.
mentions.problem: Default extension stores have seen significant ransomware and malware activity, motivating enterprises to move to a private alternative.
mentions.source_excerpt: working on building a private web store for Enterprises to switch to rather than using the default stores given all the ransomware and malware activity in that space
